load_pickle_safely: load a pickle file from a path using the restricted unpickler that only allows safe modules
load_pickle_from_file_object: load a pickle from an open file-like object using the restricted unpickler with safe module checks
load_pickle_without_warning: load a pickle file from a path using the restricted unpickler with warnings disabled
review_restricted_unpickler: review the _RestrictedUnpickler class and its find_class method that blocks unsafe module unpickling
review_safe_module_prefixes: review the _SAFE_MODULE_PREFIXES tuple to see which modules are allowed for safe pickle loading
